headline: OpenAI introduces GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol for professional work and coding
body: OpenAI says GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol come with better professional outputs, coding, computer use, and efficiency at lower cost across ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API.
note: Computer use and lower cost are the two claims that matter most to banks testing agents, and both come from OpenAI's own description.

evidence.text: Introducing GPT‑6.2 Astra and Sol, with better professional outputs, coding, computer use, and efficiency at lower cost across ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API.
